items.title: Henry "Booker T." Glass Interview, 1962-03-22
items.q: Now that's how I used to work all with them, in between, you know. They'd come and get me. But I'd pick them out, you know. They'd pick me.

ctx.x: Joe Doyard was a good trumpet player.
He was good. So he just gave it up. And this boy, Billy Moran's son, he was a good bass player. So he just... Simon. Simon was good. I was talking with Simon and Eddie.
